analysis.reasonEn: The previous 3 trading days have maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI remains in the neutral zone at 55.3, and ADX is at 16.9, indicating a pre-trend formation stage. The MACD histogram has worsened from 0.7501 to -0.1660, showing a signal of a potential bearish turn. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.76 times the 5-day average, making directional confirmation difficult.
